text: Mechi ilikuwa kali kati ya Harbour City na Seabrook Town ambapo Seabrook walizinduka katika nusu ya pili na kufunga mabao 4, wakirejea nyuma kutoka 2-0 kwa halftime. Kian Romano alifunga mabao mawili ya mwisho katika dakika za ziada, na kufanikisha ushindi wa 4-2 [#1882] [#1906]. Marek Barros wa Harbour City aliibuka kama mchezaji bora akifunga bao moja, kutoa pasi mbili za gonjwa, na kuonyesha ustadi mkubwa uwanjani. Seabrook Town waliboresha mbinu zao dakika 65, wakapiga shinikizo zaidi na kucheza mpira wa moja kwa moja, jambo lililowezesha kufanikisha mabao mengi kupitia mabadiliko ya haraka na kusaidia kupokezana mpira vizuri [#1361]. Machungu ya kadi nyekundu ya Joon Whitfield kabla ya mapumziko yalimfanya Harbour City kuchelewa kurejea uwanjani, na kuwakosesha nguvu dhidi ya ushindi wenye umaarufu wa wageni [#870].

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in sw

- Seabrook Town defeated Harbour City 4-2 with a higher xG of 3.44 compared to 1.03 for Harbour City [#all goals].
- Marek Barros (Harbour City) had a strong all-round performance: 1 goal, 2 assists, 4 tackles, 5 key passes, and 9 interceptions with a 9.8 rating [#player_of_the_match].
- Seabrook Town scored 4 goals in the second half, overturning a 2-0 halftime deficit to win 4-2 [#second_half goals].
- Kian Romano scored two late goals in stoppage time (90+2' and 90+3'), both with very high xG values of 0.605 and 0.952, to clinch the comeback [#1882, #1906].
- Harbour City received a red card at 43' (Joon Whitfield), reducing their side before conceding 4 second-half goals [#870, #871].

- Seabrook Town's goals at 53', 69', and late in stoppage time came largely from rapid regains of possession (regains at 53' and 69' leading directly to goals by Marlowe and Varga) and quick counter or direct transitions, consistent with the 3-4-3 formation's flexibility and the coach Mara Lindholm’s emphasis on wide, crossing play and increased directness after 65' when chasing the game [#1104, #1448, #1882, #1886].
- Harbour City’s first goal at 45' was the result of a prolonged patient build-up over 56.9 seconds with 17 passes, reflecting their 4-2-3-1 setup and style of patient short passing under Tomasz Rhee, culminating in a low-xG through ball by Barros to Okafor [#905].
- Marek Barros’s second goal at 47' originated from a corner (set piece) with a very long-range cross leading to an unlikely goal, showing Harbour City’s ability to utilize set pieces within their structure, despite their overall lower chance volume [#975].
- The tactical change by Seabrook Town around the 65th minute involved pressing more intensely, raising their defensive line, and playing more direct, which led to increased chances and successful exploitation of turnovers, indicating adaptation within their 3-4-3 wide system to regain initiative despite trailing [#1361].
- Harbour City’s late tactical shift at 90+2' to press higher and play more direct was a response to Seabrook’s pressing and counter-attack threat but failed to prevent conceding two late goals, highlighting the risk of overcommitting in attack against Seabrook’s effective transition play [#1884, #1886].
